meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: First on the agenda for this meeting is to elect the chair and vice chair of this committee as per Section 153 of Standing Order of Peoples’ Majlis. At the start of this meeting, the meeting was chaired by Legal Officer Faruhath Habeeb. When the floor was opened for members to propose a name for the chair of the committee, MP Azim Abdul Azeez of Vilingili Constituency proposed and MP Hussain Sameer of Thoddoo Constituency seconded the name MP Ali Moosa of Hoarafushi Constituency. The motion was passed unanimously by the members present at the time of voting. The voting details for this proposal are provided in the “Votes” section of this page. When the floor was opened to propose a name for the vice chair of the committee, MP Ali Moosa of Hoarafushi Constituency proposed and MP Hussain Sameer of Thoddoo Constituency seconded the name of MP Azim Abdul Azeez of Vilingili Constituency. The motion was passed unanimously by the members present at the time of voting. The voting details for this proposal are provided in the “Votes” section of this page. After that, MP Ali Moosa of Hoarafushi Constituency chaired this meeting. Lastly, the committee discussed reviewing of the annual reports. After discussions, MP Azim Abdul Azeez of Vilingili Constituency proposed and MP Hussain Sameer of Thoddoo Constituency seconded to meet with the Ministries and Departments and present a presentation no longer than 30 minutes regarding their annual reports to review the reports. The motion was passed unanimously by the members present at the time of voting. The voting details for this proposal are provided in the “Votes” section of this page.
